## TRANSCRIPT
[00:00] S1 (Nick): Hey everyone it's Nick just checking in.
[00:00] S1 (Nick): Um I hope you guys have had as much fun watching these videos as I have been making them.
[00:05] S1 (Nick): It is a a side hobby for me and uh one that is quite expensive and time consuming.
[00:13] S1 (Nick): And so a lot of you have asked me to set up a Patreon page to chip in a couple bucks to make sure we can continue to do this going forward.
[00:20] S1 (Nick): Um so just wanted to give you a little insight into what uh what I do and and my process.
[00:26] S1 (Nick): So I basically film on my iPhone in my kitchen at home.
[00:30] S1 (Nick): Um but I invest a lot in top quality liquors that I love and want to recommend to you guys, um as well as equipment that I use, uh whether it's a smoking gun or immersion circulator for cool infusions and and high quality glassware.
[00:44] S1 (Nick): Um and spend a lot of time doing things uh like ice experiments and um and other things of that nature.
[00:51] S1 (Nick): So it's time consuming and expensive and I want to make sure I can continue to do this and put out a regular cadence of videos for you guys.
[00:58] S1 (Nick): So uh you can head on over to my Patreon page to learn a little bit more and if you want to donate a couple bucks that would uh go a long way to making sure we can keep this up over the next year.
[01:08] S1 (Nick): Um with that money I'll be able to hopefully invest in some better equipment.
[01:12] S1 (Nick): Uh we can get a better camera, some better lighting.
[01:16] S1 (Nick): Um I'm going to be able to put out a video a week at least and uh also have a direct connection to you guys there and will uh will be prioritizing suggestions from my Patreon patrons.
[01:26] S1 (Nick): So head on over and uh would love to keep this going uh with your support.
[01:29] S1 (Nick): Thanks.

## QUOTES
- "[00:05]" "It is a a side hobby for me and uh one that is quite expensive and time consuming." -> why it reveals something: Shows honest accounting of the real costs and effort behind a creative side project.
- "[00:30]" "I invest a lot in top quality liquors that I love and want to recommend to you guys, um as well as equipment that I use..." -> why it reveals something: Demonstrates commitment to curation and quality of ingredients/tools.
- "[00:44]" "...spend a lot of time doing things uh like ice experiments and um and other things of that nature." -> why it reveals something: Highlights a dedication to mastering the technical craft details.
- "[00:51]" "...I want to make sure I can continue to do this and put out a regular cadence of videos for you guys." -> why it reveals something: Reveals a value on consistency and reliability for an audience.
- "[01:16]" "...also have a direct connection to you guys there and will uh will be prioritizing suggestions from my Patreon patrons." -> why it reveals something: Shows value placed on community input and reciprocal audience relationship.
